description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayerClient class, which manages IPC communication for WebAudioPlayer state changes, including converting internal state enums to protocol buffer messages and sending events via an IPC client.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: A class responsible for handling WebAudioPlayer state notifications and IPC event dispatching.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with a handle and IPC client reference.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Sends a state change event via IPC to notify other components of the WebAudioPlayer's current state.
